dither_counterfactual.description: Diagnostic only: compare one stochastic-Q4 realization reused at all 16 depths against 16 independent stochastic-Q4 realizations of the same FP32 shared block. Independent copies are not a same-byte deployable codec; the experiment isolates correlation as a mechanism.
dither_counterfactual.interpretation: Small and sign-unstable. Correlated error is plausible but does not explain most recurrent Q4 damage.

row_distribution.description: Per-row absmax/RMS and raw row-Q4 matrix NMSE for teacher blocks versus the recovered shared block.
row_distribution.interpretation: Shared-block rows have ~1.5x larger absmax/RMS and >2x raw row-Q4 NMSE. Finer sub-row scale grouping is therefore better supported than depth dither as the first quantization fix.
